statement: No public human lung / NSCLC ELF3 ChIP-seq was found in ENCODE, ChIP-Atlas (ELF3.5 target matrix), or a GEO ELF3+ChIP-seq survey. ELF3 binding at TACSTD2/CLDN4 therefore cannot be tested in lung from public ChIP. Available non-lung ChIP (CFPAC-1 pancreas, HepG2 liver, ESO-26 esophagus, HBDEC2 biliary) is mixed and is not a lung result.
